# A whole-domain harmonic-stability operation and its acquisition boundary

## 1. Question, prior and exact scope

The desired operation is to qualify candidate crystalline matter against arbitrarily long-wavelength and off-grid mechanical instabilities without treating a finite phonon plot as a proof. The present result is a finite certificate for a specified rational harmonic model, together with a proper central-force alias showing why a finite-supercell source does not automatically acquire that model as the true infinite-crystal Hessian. It is not a specimen-stability or synthesis certificate.

The Fourier formulation and rigorous reciprocal-space discretization are established. Hudson–Ortner, [On the stability of Bravais lattices and their Cauchy–Born approximations](https://doi.org/10.1051/m2an/2011014), Theorem3.6 and section4, provide the relevant ordinary baseline; in particular their treatment does not simply ignore the acoustic origin. Bernstein positivity and subdivision are also established validated-numerics tools. The construction here combines rational torus charts with an exact acoustic block blow-up, so ordinary polynomial positivity routines can consume a multi-site crystal without a vanishing absolute eigenvalue at the origin. Historical priority of that adaptation is UNKNOWN.

Let H_R be finitely supported real rational n-by-n force-constant blocks, n=3p, with H_-R=H_R^T. In the cell-periodic Bloch gauge define

    D(q)=sum_R H_R exp(i R.q),   q in the three-torus.

Positive masses do not affect its inertia, so they are omitted for this stability statement. Let T stack p copies of I3, and let Z=[T,Q] be any fixed invertible rational contrast basis. Assume D(0)T=0 and the acoustic first derivatives T^T partial_j D(0)T=0 exactly. These identities are checked, not inferred from small numerical residuals. Additional soft modes or quartic acoustic degeneracies fall outside the strict-coercivity case below.

## 2. Finite rational torus cover

For each center bit vector c in{0,1}^3, set

    exp(i q_j)=(-1)^c_j (1+i x_j)^2/(1+x_j^2),  -1<=x_j<=1.

These eight closed charts cover the torus. Write m_j=max_R|R_j| and

    Q0(x)=product_j(1+x_j^2)^m_j >0,
    P_c(x)=Q0(x) D(q(x)).

# Preserved failures and corrections

The first import used an unanchored substring split at `displacements:`. It matched the tail of the configuration key `create_displacements:` and incorrectly extracted a primitive-axis row (1,0,0) as the physical displacement. The resulting low-scale MODEL_PREVIEW is INVALID and retained only as FAILED_IMPORT_PREVIEW.json. The corrected parser anchors the actual top-level YAML key and checks the exact displacement norm. It imports (0,.0070710678118655,.0070710678118655) Angstrom. No certificate consumes the invalid model.

The initial20,000-node full-chart run stopped during regular001. Its BOUNDED_ATTEMPT_INCOMPLETE status is preserved in GLOBAL_CERTIFICATE_first.json; complete acoustic subtrees and the partial regular subtree remain in LEAVES_first.json.gz. Exact axis permutation and real-coefficient conjugation reduced repeated domains for the continuation; no new material, parameter fixture or unconverged positive assertion was substituted. The independent consumer later verifies all retained and newly acquired leaves.

At the selected trial vector the initial unit-strength central alias gave a positive Rayleigh value .23227856217424367. That failed trial does not prove the unit-strength model globally stable. A sufficient integer strength7 was then constructed directly from the two exact trial ratios, giving negative witnesses at both the rational phase and quarter-q. No continuous strength grid was searched.

GitHub text transport left one additional trailing LF in the numerical source views. Exact original bytes were recovered by removing that one byte and verified against every Git blob SHA. Both originals and numerical views are retained, with the exact relation in TRANSPORT_RECEIPT.json. Source decimals, geometry and every arithmetic coefficient are identical; the model/certificate inputs were not changed or rerun for this whitespace-only transport receipt.

The ambitious source-to-physical-stability implication failed at a stronger level than an uncertified off-grid plot: a smooth radial central interaction on an isolated shell is invisible to all source-sized supercell-periodic force histories. This is a data-only identification boundary. It does not refute an actual known silicon Hamiltonian, all finite-range constitutive approaches or the whole-domain receiver under a warranted error/range promise.
